[aaa]
| set system authentication-order tacplus
* set system tacplus-server 10.0.0.42 secret prod-secret-0123456789abcdef
| set system tacplus-server 10.0.0.42 single-connection
| set system accounting events [ login change-log ]
| set system accounting destination tacplus
[roles]
| set system login class RO-CLASS permissions network
| set system login class RO-CLASS permissions view
| set system login class RO-CLASS permissions view-configuration
| set system login user RO-CLASS class RO-CLASS
| set system login class OP-CLASS permissions clear
| set system login class OP-CLASS permissions network
| set system login class OP-CLASS permissions trace
| set system login class OP-CLASS permissions view
| set system login class OP-CLASS permissions view-configuration
| set system login user OP-CLASS class OP-CLASS
| set system login class RW-CLASS permissions all
| set system login user RW-CLASS class RW-CLASS
| set system login class EN-CLASS permissions [ view view-configuration network clear trace reset configure rollback interface interface-control routing routing-control firewall firewall-control system system-control snmp ]
| set system login user EN-CLASS class EN-CLASS
[mgmt-acl]
| set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from source-address 10.0.0.42/32
| set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from source-address 10.0.0.0/8
| set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from protocol tcp
| set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from destination-port [ ssh 830 ]
| set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt then accept
| set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-mgmt from protocol tcp
| set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-mgmt from destination-port [ ssh 830 ]
| set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-mgmt then { log; discard; }
| set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp from source-address 10.0.0.42/32
| set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp from source-address 198.51.100.0/24
| set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp from protocol udp
| set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp from destination-port snmp
| set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp then accept
| set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-snmp from protocol udp
| set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-snmp from destination-port snmp
| set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-snmp then { log; discard; }
| set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term default-accept then accept
[snmp]
| set snmp client-list TACCTL-SNMP 10.0.0.42/32
| set snmp client-list TACCTL-SNMP 198.51.100.0/24
| set snmp client-list TACCTL-SNMP 0.0.0.0/0 restrict
* set snmp v3 usm local-engine user tacctl-ro authentication-sha authentication-password "auth-pass-0123"
* set snmp v3 usm local-engine user tacctl-ro privacy-aes128 privacy-password "priv-pass-4567"
| set snmp v3 vacm security-to-group security-model usm security-name tacctl-ro group TACCTL-GROUP
| set snmp v3 vacm access group TACCTL-GROUP default-context-prefix security-model usm security-level privacy read-view TACCTL-VIEW
| set snmp view TACCTL-VIEW oid .1 include
| set snmp location "Rack 4, DC1"
| set snmp contact "NOC <noc@example.net>"
| set snmp description "Core switch"
[netconf] not rendered
[breakglass] not rendered
